reviews.text: Matilda is the most amazing stylist and an even more amazing human! I got the most gorgeous copper color with some highlights and a fantastic haircut! She even faded my undercut for me! Do yourself a favor and get in her chair!! Much love!
Amy does amazing work! She is so kind and easy to talk to. I got partial foil, cut, and blow out and I’m in love! I definitely will be returning regularly!

I love the way Caitlin cuts/shapes my hair. When I ask her questions about my hair, she always explains the best way or products to use. I appreciate her advice and being a very informative hair stylist.
